changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionStatusLog') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionStatusLog_Fusion' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionStatusLog' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionStatusLog] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionStatusLog_Fusion] END exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionStatusLog', 'FusionStatusLog_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionStatusLog_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionStatusLog_backup', 'FusionStatusLog'; END
